events.title: Tencent opens OmniEVIE-4B for multimodal retrieval
events.title_zh: Tencent 开放多模态检索模型 OmniEVIE-4B
events.summary: Tencent released OmniEVIE-4B, a 4.54B-parameter Apache-2.0 retrieval model for text, images, visual documents and native video. It ships weights, inference and indexing code, checksums and a technical report. Its multi-vector index can localize matching page regions or video intervals, while all reported quality and latency results are publisher-run.
events.summary_en: Tencent released OmniEVIE-4B, a 4.54B-parameter Apache-2.0 retrieval model for text, images, visual documents and native video. It ships weights, inference and indexing code, checksums and a technical report. Its multi-vector index can localize matching page regions or video intervals, while all reported quality and latency results are publisher-run.
events.summary_zh: Tencent 发布 OmniEVIE-4B：一个 4.54B 参数、Apache-2.0 的检索模型，覆盖文本、图片、视觉文档和原生视频。权重、推理与建库代码、校验和及技术报告均已公开。多向量索引可以定位匹配的页面区域或视频片段，但质量与延迟数字都来自发布方。
events.why_it_matters: Multimodal RAG teams can test one self-hosted retriever across documents and video with fine-grained localization, instead of stitching together separate text and vision stacks.
events.why_it_matters_en: Multimodal RAG teams can test one self-hosted retriever across documents and video with fine-grained localization, instead of stitching together separate text and vision stacks.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对多模态 RAG 团队来说，可以用一个自托管 retriever 统一处理文档与视频，并定位细粒度命中，不必拼接多套文本和视觉检索系统。

technical_details.modalities: Text, natural images, visual documents and native video
technical_details.index: Late-interaction multi-vector; compressed configuration up to 128 int8 vectors of 64 dimensions
technical_details.footprint: Publisher reports up to 9,472 bytes per record and 8.82 GiB per million records; K32 at 2.15 GiB per million pages
technical_details.publisher_latency: 54.2 ms across 1M records and 120.2 ms across 5M records on one CPU thread after GPU encoding
technical_details.publisher_quality: 60.68 full and 60.06 compressed across MMEB-V3 190 tasks
technical_details.availability: Apache-2.0 weights and code; self-hosted package; flash-attn >=2.7.0; no hosted API or price found

technical_details_zh.模态: 文本、自然图像、视觉文档与原生视频
technical_details_zh.索引: Late-interaction 多向量；压缩配置最多 128 个 int8、64 维向量
technical_details_zh.占用: 发布方称每条最多 9,472 字节、每百万条 8.82 GiB；K32 每百万页 2.15 GiB
technical_details_zh.发布方延迟: GPU 编码后单 CPU 线程检索 100 万条 54.2 ms、500 万条 120.2 ms
technical_details_zh.发布方质量: MMEB-V3 190 项任务：完整模型 60.68，压缩模型 60.06
technical_details_zh.可用性: Apache-2.0 权重与代码；自托管 package；需 flash-attn >=2.7.0；未发现托管 API 或价格
technical_details_zh.时间依据: Hugging Face 创建于 2026-11-24T03:16:57Z；GitHub 创建于 03:09:40Z

events.next_action_en: Within one day, index PDFs, screenshots and short videos; compare recall/nDCG, localization, index size and query latency with the current retriever.
